originality.rationale: The present finite graph is the 14-vertex cube-face incidence graph, not the 20-vertex ordinary dodecahedral graph or the 12-vertex cuboctahedral dual. Literature on general finite two-periodicity, probabilistic majority, and generic convergence-time bounds has different quantifiers and does not determine its exact 46/183 recurrent census, 7,160-state oscillatory basin, 48-symmetry orbit classes, or sharp time five. Targeted alias/parameter searches of published findings and primary literature found no equivalent enumeration. Priority is qualified by unindexed work.
